message.content: Li Hua expresses a very positive impression of the Blood and Wine expansion, describing it as "incredible." She notes that the new area of Toussaint is stunning and the story feels like a mini-epic in itself. Additionally, she highlights the memorable characters in this expansion, saying that the unique chemistry between Geralt and Yennefer adds significant depth to the game. Li Hua also mentions that the visual aspects of the arena during the tournament quest were particularly impressive, further emphasizing her enjoyment of the Blood and Wine expansion.
